rederived_oracles.method: Independent linear algebra (own numpy script, no import of radiosim.core.polarization): built B_NE=(1/2)(I*I2+Q*diag(1,-1)+U*[[0,1],[1,0]]+V*[[0,i],[-i,0]]) for arbitrary (I,Q,U,V)=(3.0,0.7,-0.4,0.25), applied D=diag(-1,1) as B_thetaphi=D@B_NE@D, read (I_H,Q_H) off the diagonal and (U_H,V_H) off the off-diagonal against Shaw's own oppositely-signed P^V=[[0,-i],[i,0]] template (the sign flip Section 5.2 itself names), and confirmed I_H=I, Q_H=Q, U_H=-U, V_H=V exactly. Separately called radiosim.core.jones.parallactic.ParallacticAngleJones(mount_types=('fixed',)).is_identity() and mount_types=(None,)).is_identity() directly (both True) and mount_types=('alt-az',)).is_identity() as a negative control (False), confirming P is exactly the identity for the shipped fixed/unspecified mounts prior to and independent of any m-mode kernel code. max abs residual across (I_H,Q_H,U_H,V_H).
